settings.relation: Warren Shanti is a self-taught handpan artist and teacher who discovered music through pure intuition, without any prior experience or formal training in music theory. His journey with the handpan is deeply meditative, centred on listening, exploration, and a profound connection with the instrument. This unique approach has birthed his debut album, "I Am With You," a soulful expression of emotions that words cannot capture.
settings.quote: What fascinates me most about Ayasa is that each handpan is a true masterpiece, both visually and musically. Every instrument is crafted with meticulous precision, designed to deliver an incomparable quality, where each note resonates with balance and exceptional purity. The unique timbre of Ayasa handpans, unmatched by any other maker, offers me a deep connection to my inner musicality and opens an infinite gateway to an inexhaustible source of inspiration.
settings.relation_more:
Warren shares his passion through live performances and by leading handpan workshops for all levels, both in groups and individually. His active presence on social media plays a crucial role in spreading the spiritual essence of the handpan globally.

As a sound and energetic healer, Warren integrates the handpan into his sound healing sessions and wellness retreats, creating immersive and transformative experiences. His music serves as a bridge to deeper emotional and spiritual connection, using the handpan as a powerful tool for inner peace and well-being.
